title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics integration and prompt-quality gating hook
author: Priya Patel
description: Context: We need finer-grained CI signals for per-prompt regressions and an automated quality gating hook to block merges when prompt-set metrics degrade. Summary: Add a per-prompt metrics reporter to the eval-harness CI flow, wire it into GitHub Actions, and implement a reversible prompt-quality gating hook that compares current run metrics against baseline thresholds stored in S3. Includes rework of test fixtures and a small SDK helper for metrics upload. Related Linear: ENG-2481, ENG-2523. Checklist: [x] implement metrics reporter, [x] add GH Action job, [x] add gating hook, [x] update docs and runbooks, [x] add unit and integration tests, [x] address reviewer feedback. Test plan: CI integration runs with sample prompt sets, end-to-end on canary branch against staging S3, manual validation of gating behavior. Rollout: feature flagged off by default; gating enabled for eval-harness-owned repos after a one-week monitoring window.

release_notes: Added per-prompt CI metrics reporting and a reversible prompt-quality gating hook to block merges on prompt-set regressions; feature is feature-flagged and off by default. See eval-harness/docs/ci.md for configuration and runbook.
notes: This PR is part of a cross-team initiative to reduce production regressions introduced by prompt edits; followups planned to add alerting and Grafana dashboards for per-prompt trends.
